name: Fix three GPU tests that abort on the C backend
body: `nox test tests/gpu --backend c` aborts in a-lit-cube-lines-and-text-appear-where-expected, an-off-screen-renderer-draws-without-a-window and released-resources-leave-stale-handles, on 568b81a as well as after the L8 follow-ups, under Xvfb with lavapipe. The x86-64 backend passes all five, and tools/run-tests.sh (x86-64) passes 186 of 186. Find whether it's a Nox C-emitter gap (card on the Nox board) or a Lantern bug that only the C build exposes.

comments.text: Not a bug. Run by hand, `nox test` doesn't set LANTERN_SHADER_DIRECTORY, so the C build looked for shaders beside its own executable (`SDL_LoadFile(.../../shaders/compiled/lit.vert.spv)`) and the rig skipped, which LANTERN_REQUIRE_GPU=1 turns into an abort. tools/run-tests.sh sets the variable; with it, `nox test tests/gpu --backend c` passes 5 of 5.
